promise: Run your dealership from one system.
lede: Sales and service are one price per user. Add the website, then add a rooftop for each extra store.
includedLine: Each user includes customers, the units they own, a calendar, and tasks.
annualNote: Annual billing is ten months of the monthly price. Two months are included.

modules.name: Sales CRM
modules.definition: Sales CRM is the path from a new lead to a sold unit: inventory, quotes, and the customers you already know.
modules.story: Work a lead through the inventory, a quote, and the close. The customer record keeps every unit they have owned beside the deal.
features: Customers and the units they own

modules.name: Service CRM
modules.definition: Service CRM runs the service lane: requests, estimates your customer can approve, and the work on the board.
modules.story: Take a request, send an estimate the owner can approve, and keep the day visible on the tech workboard.

modules.name: Marketing
modules.definition: Marketing keeps the brand, the ads, and the social plan in the same place as the inventory and the events.
modules.story: Write the brand once, then plan ads and social posts around the inventory and events already on the floor.

modules.name: Website
modules.definition: Website is the public site for your inventory, events, and parts counter, and it sends new leads back into DealerAgent.
modules.story: Publish the inventory, the events, and the parts counter. Inventory search and the lead forms bring the next conversation back to the store.

dealershipOs.name: Dealership OS
dealershipOs.definition: Dealership OS is the full store: the sales floor, the service lane, and the books, in one system.
dealershipOs.body: The four modules cover how you sell, how you service, how you market, and the site customers see. The operating system is the rest of the rooftop, including parts and the books. It is coming soon and is not for sale yet.

faqs.question: Who is DealerAgent for?
faqs.answer: Dealerships. The modules cover sales, service, marketing, and the public website.

faqs.question: How does pricing work?
faqs.answer: Sales and service access is $99 per user each month, and marketing is included. The website is $399 a month. Each rooftop after the first is $299 a month.

faqs.question: Is the dealership operating system available?
faqs.answer: Dealership OS is coming soon and is not for sale yet.

faqs.question: How does annual billing work?
faqs.answer: Annual billing is ten months of the monthly price. Two months are included.
